== Title ==
<span lang="ja">帝国軍分隊指揮官</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">きっちり３人の兵員／トルーパーからなる“分隊”とともに移動する場合、１フォースで４人全員が移動できる。同じ位置カード上の兵員／トルーパーはそれぞれ没収値＋１。「帝国軍警備兵員」は分隊指揮官と一緒であれば移動可能となる（フォースは通常通り消費する）。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">モッド・テリック大尉は、デザート・サンズ・サンドトルーパー部隊のごく典型的な士官である。勇敢で忠誠心が強い。必要とあらば、兵員たちを犠牲にすることも厭わない。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Imperial Squad Leader]].

'''Lore''' — Captain Mod Terrik is a typical officer of the Desert Sands sandtrooper unit. He is brave and loyal. If necessary, he does not hesitate to sacrifice his troops.

'''Game text''' — When moving with a “squad” of exactly three troopers, all four may move for 1 Force. Troopers at the same location card are each forfeit +1. Imperial Trooper Guards may move if they are with the squad leader, using Force as usual.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese uses 位置カード where the English uses site, and 兵員／トルーパー for troopers. Lore says brave and loyal rather than fearless and highly motivated. The Guards clause names 帝国軍警備兵員 and 分隊指揮官.<ref>[[:File:ANewHope-D-imperialsquadleader-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Imperial Squad Leader]].</ref>
